_about: Loan-reason checker test set. 'pass' = real reasons lenders funded (must come back good or tip). 'nudge' = no real purpose (vague or placeholder). 'not_english' = must be rejected with an English translation as the suggestion. 'not_allowed' = purposes we never fund. Run: node tools/eval-loan-reason.mjs
